### The Peace and Purity of the Church
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-peace-and-purity-of-the-church
Passage: Ephesians 6:23-24
Points:
- Paul concludes his letter by praying for peace and love with faith from God.
- Biblical peace encompasses both reconciliation with God and loving harmony among believers.
- Christian love must remain firmly anchored in the objective truth of the gospel.
- Authentic faith proves itself through love that works to tear down ungodly divisions.
- Believers are called to actively pursue both doctrinal purity and church unity for God's glory.
